description: Defines a template class MultiStateCounter for tracking changes of a value over time across multiple states, including methods for updating, resetting, and retrieving state data. Contains implementation inline due to template usage.

classes.name: MultiStateCounter
classes.description: A template class for tracking a value's changes over multiple states, considering time spent in each state.

methods.name: MultiStateCounter
methods.description: Constructor initializing the counter with number of states and an empty value.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the counter, updating timestamps accordingly.

methods.name: setState
methods.description: Sets the current state and updates time-in-state metrics.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets the counter value for a specific state.

methods.name: updateValue
methods.description: Updates the counter value, distributing delta across states based on time in each state.

methods.name: incrementValue
methods.description: Increments the counter value by a specified amount.

methods.name: addValue
methods.description: Adds a value to the current state's counter without affecting timestamps.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the counter and state metrics.

methods.name: getCount
methods.description: Retrieves the counter value for a specific state.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the counter's current state.
